text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, the color payoff is so good!\nAnd 
the case is super cute, too♪"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right, yeah! ...Except when I read 
the description, it said it was meant for 
"warm tones."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san told me before that I have cool 
undertones... and so—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I looked it up, it said cool tones 
don't look good with warm tone stuff, 
so—...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you thought this color was 
lovely, right Yukino-chan?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! It feels so "modern" and 
"city-girl"-like, so cool!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You know, personal color analysis is super 
helpful for bringing out your shine, 
but... you don't have to let it stop you 
from trying new things.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary! It's an approach that 
teaches you how to coordinate and pull off 
wearing that color!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of constitution you 
have, with a little ingenuity, you can 
achieve a brilliant running style 
—something like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright! I'm gonna give this "eye 
shadow" a try!!
